implemented_partial_schema.trusted_boundary: Independent verify reconstructs typing, CFG/dominance, initialization/storage, affine address/environment transfers, closure call kind, shape/bounds and origin/liveness/loan-parent facts. It independently checks scalar and bounded borrowed-buffer foreign declaration shape, exact noescape indices, simultaneous address permissions and balanced lexical unsafe CFG regions. C implementation behavior and the truth of explicit unsafe foreign contracts remain trusted; neither source spans nor a declaration prove them. Analyze and verify do not share their safety solver. LLVM consumes LIR bound to immutable VerifiedModule; no Rust borrow checker, implicit Box/RC or default noalias is used. Finite resource origin, linear SSA/local obligations, description liveness and conditional cleanup are independently reconstructed. Drop hidden entry points cannot be ordinary calls or function references. Explicit scopes independently bind parameter/local storage activation, exact stack/storage joins and ordered exits. The scope checker concerns local storage, while owned SSA block results remain subject to the full-function affine responsibility checker. Error exit labels must accompany an actual constructed error result; ordinary Return may return either tag. All executable non-foreign source-defined functions use scopes; legacy unscoped non-error raw IR retains its independent resource checks without a lexical scope claim. Local resource environments carry affine debts; Analyze and Verify independently reconstruct owned/borrowed capture roots, liveness, transfer, normal cleanup and transitive descriptor write effects. Copy payload snapshots do not inherit write-through descriptor provenance. ReadCapture cannot copy Managed; shared owned calls use the actual local environment. Field and local liveness flags enforce the checked normal and finite synchronous error cleanup at machine level. Package type shape, owned field arity/consumption, exact field Desc roots and whole carrier debt are independently checked. Every Package type or operation requires strict explicit storage scopes, including raw IR. Concrete helper contracts are independently rebuilt; public claims cannot grant a borrow, authorize borrowed-environment teardown or hide captured-address loans. Borrowing the environment position preserves its captured address Hold. Ordinary helper calls compare all carried loan windows and actual shared/exclusive permissions; future-live captured field descriptions prevent whole Package movement. Package locals additionally retain independent owning-field debts (a complete owning-array field is one field obligation) and an active shell; complete SSA/ABI transfers require every owned field LIVE. Exact field Desc roots block only the invalidated field, while whole operations check all roots. Explicit conditional field cleanup precedes a prepared mutable field Store; raw Store cannot overwrite live debt. Partial local cleanup visits only actually live fields in declaration order. Package environment views are uniquely rebound from raw entry structure by each checker; Shared indirect writes and all normal/error nonconsuming exit shapes are independently checked. Bind/End cannot reset the persistent environment debt.

implemented_partial_schema.shared_capture_scope: One-level shared/exclusive references to finite Copy values, including parameters and borrowed returns. Projections keep conservative whole-object roots and checked bounds. Default mutable Value capture uses its real address; existing addresses reborrow by use, while move transfers mutable addresses. Local Desc capture observes current resource heads; Managed capture transfers ownership at creation. Explicit move of a complete finite Package creates an owned environment field. implemented_partial_schema.core_additions: Core Enum/Match/IfLet/WhileLet/Ascribed/Unsafe remain unverified syntax. CoreField.public retains field visibility. Project templates normalize to definition-module identities before finite specialization; private field access and source construction are checked while legitimate CT value copies remain possible. Aliases/generics re-enter ordinary checks; raw walks are bounded. Core Try remains unverified syntax and must be traversed by inference, CT source/materialization and raw walkers; ErrorUnion children are visited recursively. IntegerConvert { value, target } is an untrusted Core expression; all traversals charge and visit operand and target. Literal(Constant) carries untrusted static foreign constants; c_callback remains a Core Call until checked. implemented_partial_schema.compile_time_program: Only explicitly serializable Unit/bool/u8/i32/i64 and nested tuple/record/array values enter the bounded CT VM. Calls, recursion, branches, loops and aggregate operations consume cumulative steps and expanded logical-cell budgets. Enum/function-pointer/address execution remains closed. CT values are materialized with fresh NodeIds into unverified Core; empty-array element types are retained through Ascribed and rechecked. ScopeEnter/ScopeExit are verified no-ops whose actual VM visits consume cumulative steps. ErrorUnion and runtime error instructions are not CT executable capabilities. Package values and operations remain non-executable in the CT VM; admission walks still charge their full raw type trees.

implemented_partial_schema.foreign_declaration: ForeignDeclaration { abi, symbol, noescape_parameters, static_callbacks }. Private C imports accept u8/u16/i32/i64/ForeignHandle/CWideString/ForeignCallback values; result only Unit/u8/u16/i32/i64/ForeignHandle. One Address layer, exact noescape indices. Readonly POD: integers, handle, static wide/callback and recursively nonempty arrays/records. Mutable POD excludes static wide/callback; all declared fields have every bit pattern valid. Natural declaration-order C layout only on supported x64 little-endian Linux and Win64 targets, by-address aggregates only, padding not field data. New static value types/record ABI unsupported elsewhere. Callback-valued parameters require static_callbacks=true; true also admits reentry via earlier registrations. Foreign callbacks must not access current borrowed ZIL storage. No cross-boundary unwind/longjmp/suspend or borrowed-address retention. Existing independent loan and unsafe checks remain; no inferred noalias/nocapture. C contract truth and OS resource validity remain unsafe obligations.
implemented_partial_schema.resource_definition: TypedModule/LirModule.resources: ordered ResourceDefinition { name, payload, teardown: optional FunctionId }. User payloads are nominal finite Copy Records; ByteBuffer and owned_store20 use their exact sealed builtin payload and canonical definition with no user teardown. A user teardown has exactly one matching Desc argument and a unit body; backend binds this table to the same immutable VerifiedModule.
implemented_partial_schema.resource_modes: CoreFunction, TypedFunction and ScalarFunction retain result_mode. Managed results require Create or Give; ordinary resource inputs are Desc, give inputs Managed. Module fingerprint and exported interface signature bind result modes; source CT traversal preserves them.
implemented_partial_schema.resource_machine: Managed uses inline payload plus a real local live flag; Desc uses a plain pointer without noalias. Store sets the flag, Take clears it, conditional Drop clears it before calling verified teardown. Default checked traps abort the process and do not unwind.
implemented_partial_schema.closure_resource_machine: Inline environment fields in first-use capture order; Each Managed capture has an appended i1 liveness flag; each Package capture has an appended shell flag followed by one i1 per direct Managed field in declaration order. Capture groups follow declaration order. Owning Shared, Exclusive and Consume entries receive an environment pointer; Copy Shared entries retain by-value ABI. TakeCapture clears field responsibility before transfer; DropClosure clears local activation before conditional field teardown. CallClosureOnce consumes an affine environment and uses fixed entry-block scratch, then cleans its remaining live fields on normal return. No implicit heap/RC/locks or noalias promise.
implemented_partial_schema.closure_resource_scope: Local concrete environments and one concrete nonescaping ordinary helper parameter. Callback explicit parameters/results remain finite Copy. Ownership does not force FnOnce: owned readonly is Fn, owned mutation (including indirect writes) FnMut, body give from a Managed capture FnOnce; Package field take followed by full restoration on every normal/error exit can remain FnMut, while a missing field/whole package on any ordinary exit requires FnOnce. Desc target mutation may remain Fn but is checked against current target liveness. No unwind or cancellation is inferred from normal Return cleanup.
implemented_partial_schema.error_union: Type::ErrorUnion { error, result } admits the base recursively finite Copy case and the finite Copy/complete Package alternatives in owned_error_union19. Exact whole-union values pass through; implicit injection requires a unique exact payload type. Equal alternatives reject ambiguous injection; no implicit error conversion. Core Try consumes one operand and propagates only an error with the exact enclosing error type.
implemented_partial_schema.cleanup_scope: Root ScopeEnter is first in every executable non-foreign source-defined function, including CT functions; parameters activate in the root. Foreign declarations have no executable source body or root scope. StorageLive binds locals to the innermost scope, StorageDead ends activation, and all exits must match innermost scope and end its storage. Joins/backedges require exact stack/storage equality. Return closes all scopes; Error additionally returns an actual true-tag MakeErrorUnion. Break/Continue encode exits but do not independently prove source-label identity. Owned SSA results can cross inner scope exits only while preserving full-function responsibility.
implemented_partial_schema.error_machine: Inline { i1, E, T } with true for error, false for success and zeroed inactive field. This stores both payloads; it is not a compact max-size union or Rust Result ABI equivalence. ReadErrorUnion checks tag before Copy extraction or Unit erasure and traps on inactive projection. Native main success is i32 or Unit only, returning the success integer or 0; error returns 1 without implicit output. Ordinary local cleanup occurs in the function CFG. For an admitted Package error payload, ownership transfers at Return to the native entry wrapper, which cleans that active error payload exactly once before returning 1.
implemented_partial_schema.source_error_cleanup: Earlier evaluated owning arguments and FnOnce callees are stored in temporary local carriers until all arguments succeed; later errors clean remaining actual responsibility. Vacant temporary storage is reserved at lexical entry, Store initializes responsibility, full-expression Drop remains at evaluation boundaries, and StorageDead occurs at scope exit. Failure snapshots do not remove success-path temporaries. Existing Copy-only resource fields establish Managed only after all field expressions succeed; general owning partial initialization is not implemented.
implemented_partial_schema.package_value: Type::Package is a finite inline non-Copy nominal Value with at least one direct supported Managed field and otherwise finite Copy fields or the bounded complete owning arrays in package_array_fields20. SSA and ordinary Infer parameter/results are complete. Local shells may hold a subset of owning field debts; whole transfer requires every owned field LIVE. Direct nested Package/Closure/Desc/Address fields, Store fields, custom whole Drop and default borrowed captures remain closed. Complete Packages may be owned error-union alternatives and fixed-array elements; explicit-move Package captures retain the narrower direct-Managed plus Copy shape.
implemented_partial_schema.package_preparation: Source fields evaluate once in written order, followed by omitted Copy defaults in declaration order. Real owning locals guard each successfully prepared owning field, including the whole-array fields in package_array_fields20. Later failure cleans guards in reverse actual initialization order. Successful MakePackage consumes every owned SSA input exactly once and initializes a complete carrier atomically. Partial construction is not exposed; later explicit direct field transfer may leave an active local shell partially populated.
implemented_partial_schema.package_description: ReadPackageField reads a matching Copy field of an active local shell, including partial shells. DescribePackageField additionally requires its Managed field LIVE. Analyze and Verify independently retain exact (LocalId, field index) roots through aliases, captures and joins. Future-live descriptions block that field Take/Drop/Store; sibling fields remain independent. Whole movement, overwrite, cleanup and storage termination check all field roots. A replaced field cannot retarget an old description to the new instance.
implemented_partial_schema.package_machine: The complete LLVM value remains the original inline struct and ordinary by-value ABI. Package locals track a whole-shell obligation plus one live flag per owning field; a whole-array field flag represents its complete element responsibility, initialized on complete parameter/Store, cleared on whole Take and storage reset. TakePackageField clears only its field; DropPackageField clears its actual flag before teardown; StorePackageField establishes a fresh field debt only after the checked old debt is absent. DropPackage clears the shell then conditionally cleans remaining live fields in declaration order. Ordinary value ABI stays complete. For the narrower direct-Managed plus Copy capture shape, captured Package shell/field flags are persistent closure-environment fields and lexical views alias them; partial ordinary Package ABI remains closed. No implicit allocation, Box, RC, lock, global table or noalias promise.
implemented_partial_schema.concrete_helper_core: CoreFunction.callable_parameter preserves one bounded F:Fn/FnMut/FnOnce template and exact callback parameter index, argument/result types. Types specializes only after the actual ClosureId is known, using a bounded work queue and template/environment cache. Definition-module names and source origins are preserved. This is not function-pointer erasure or caller-side inlining.
implemented_partial_schema.concrete_helper_contract: TypedFunction.callable_contract is an untrusted CallableParameterContract { parameter, closure, kind, hold, call, writes, cleanup, traces }. Hold indexes captured Address fields; Call indexes captured Address/Desc dependencies. Writes is the conservative capability upper bound of all Desc and mutable Address fields, not a claim of actual mutation. Cleanup is Owned or Borrowed. Sorted unique traces contain 0/1/2 exact requested callback modes and Return/Trap exits. Return includes either Copy E!T tag; no error-tag correlation is exported. Independent Verify reconstructs this relation from an acyclic CFG and checked capture types; caller effects consume only the verified public relation.
implemented_partial_schema.concrete_helper_scope: One concrete environment parameter: F or &F for Fn, &mut F for FnMut, F for FnOnce. By-value FnMut is Unsupported in this slice because ordinary parameters are immutable. Actual Fn supports requested Fn/FnMut/FnOnce; actual FnMut supports FnMut/FnOnce; actual FnOnce supports only FnOnce. FnOnce traces contain at most one call. Other parameters are finite Copy, complete Package, or Managed give values; extra Desc/Address parameters and non-Copy results are closed. No helper loops, callback forwarding/recursive helper contracts, environment fabrication of the same identity, escape or persistence. Unknown contracts/effects are never treated as empty.
implemented_partial_schema.concrete_helper_machine: Closure(id) remains the actual inline environment type and Address<Closure(id)> is an actual pointer to its storage. CallClosureBorrowed invokes the original entry: owning/FnMut/FnOnce entries receive ptr; a nonowning read-only Fn retains its existing by-value ABI and only its nonowning environment fields are loaded. No owned environment is copied through LoadAddress. Fn/FnMut adapted to by-value FnOnce are consumed in fixed entry scratch and their remaining owned fields are cleaned exactly once in capture order. Borrowed environments acquire no cleanup debt. Earlier prepared owning callback/arguments remain guarded if a later argument propagates error.
implemented_partial_schema.concrete_helper_interface: ScalarInterface.callable_contracts is None before Verify and Some verified public concrete-instance contracts afterward. Driver contract fingerprint domain v2 binds the canonical contract bytes. Concrete instance signature hashing binds ClosureId plus actual capture layout, call kind and callback signature; body-only edits need not change signature. LIR must match the exact immutable verified functions/environments/resources. Legacy ordinary non-helper Desc calls retain their earlier effect analysis; this slice does not claim universal separate-compilation contracts.
implemented_partial_schema.retained_callable_core: CoreFunction.callable_return: Option<CoreCallableReturn { kind, parameters, result }> preserves one return-position impl Fn/FnMut/FnOnce declaration. Core Opaque markers are unresolved claims only. Types resolves grounded factory dependencies before consumers and preserves one source opaque identity per declaration; all reachable returns have its exact concrete hidden type. Forwarding can retain the actual hidden ClosureId of another resolved factory. Recursive factory dependencies and implicit kind adaptation remain unsupported.
implemented_partial_schema.retained_callable_contract: TypedFunction.callable_return_contract: Option<CallableReturnContract { closure, kind, hold, call, writes, cleanup }>. Return type is concrete Closure(id), result_mode Infer, definition is ordinary nonforeign/nonclosure/nonhelper. Captures are finite Copy snapshots, direct Managed fields, complete Packages or recursively self-contained concrete Closures; callback explicit parameters/result are finite Copy. Declared kind equals actual kind in this slice. External hold/call/writes are empty; cleanup lists the Managed, Package and nested Closure capture indices in field order. Independent Verify checks the claim against the actual definition, grounded creation/forwarding and return CFG; missing/forged claims grant no authority.
implemented_partial_schema.retained_callable_machine: Existing inline environment struct (including owned-field live flags) returns by value to caller; MakeClosure/Return transfers responsibility once and caller Store receives it. Calls retain the actual environment position and FnOnce uses fixed scratch with remaining-field cleanup. No implicit allocation, box, RC, lock or registration table. Retaining a self-contained value across synchronous caller iterations is supported; external retained callbacks, cancellation, reentrancy and quiescence are not claimed.
implemented_partial_schema.retained_callable_interface: ScalarInterface.callable_returns is None before Verify and Some<Vec<FunctionCallableReturn {name,contract}>> afterward. Verified public contract fingerprint domain v3 binds parameter and return contracts; signature binds actual closure layout/kind/parameter/result types. Opaque hides a source type name, not required layout or semantic contract.
implemented_partial_schema.package_field_update: Source give p.field transfers one Managed field; a plain whole-field value expression transfers an admitted owning array. Both permit an immutable let binding, as whole affine move does. Field assignment requires var; evaluate the static local target once, fully prepare RHS under real temporary ownership, then explicit conditional DropPackageField and non-failing StorePackageField. RHS preparation failure leaves any unconsumed old field intact; prior RHS side effects are not rolled back. Copy fields Store directly. LIVE|MOVED joins may be conditionally cleaned before refill. A missing/inactive shell, mismatched field, live destination debt, stale description or duplicate SSA use is rejected. Teardown panic retains the existing abort boundary; no recoverable error/unwind/suspend is added.

package_capture.binding: Each actual Package capture has exactly one same-type non-parameter local view, bound once in the entry root ScopeEnter plus consecutive BindPackageCapture prefix. Entry has no incoming edge. Index/local mapping is one-to-one; no views in non-environment functions. All Package views precede ordinary capture initialization.
package_capture.storage: Bind/End are the only lexical activation/deactivation. Ordinary StorageLive/StorageDead, Package ReadCapture/TakeCapture and whole BorrowLocal(view) are rejected. Bind sets initialized and End clears it without requiring a still-initialized Consume value. End changes no physical debt flags; it forbids future use or live descriptions/aliases and must precede root ScopeExit. No rebind or ordinary reverse-init local cleanup ordering.
package_capture.machine: View data, shell flag and each Managed field flag alias the actual environment. Bind/End need no runtime flag writes or whole-package copying. Final cleanup is capture declaration order then field declaration order, conditional on persistent flags, after a consuming call returns.
package_capture.mode: Shared forbids all direct/transitive writes or debt changes. Exclusive requires shell and every Managed field exactly LIVE on every normal/error Return. Consume may leave partial or moved whole state; caller cleans remaining env flags. Non-Shared whole Take/Drop/Store retains complete-transfer and no-old-debt rules. Trap remains abort.
package_capture.inference: Explicit move only. Budgeted source slot-state flow classifies pure-read Fn, writing with full restoration on all ordinary/error exits FnMut, any partial/whole-moved exit FnOnce. Classification grants no safety facts; independent Analyze/Verify reconstruct actual CFG, scoped views, liveness and resource state.
package_capture.boundary: Only direct Managed plus finite Copy Package shape; no nested owning fields, whole custom Drop, default borrowed captures, Package explicit callable arguments/results or implicit heap/RC. Ordinary self-contained factory inputs may include complete Package.

byte_integer.representation: u8 is 0..255, inline i8 with size/alignment1, all bit patterns valid; ordinary parameters/results use ZIL internal ABI. C by-value u8 is outside this slice.
byte_integer.operations: checked add/subtract/multiply and 0-x negate; modulo256 explicit wrapping; unsigned comparison/division/remainder and logical right shift. Only u8 shifts are newly admitted: count<8, left shift discards high bits. Other signed shift admission is unchanged. Exact same operand type, no implicit widening.
byte_integer.conversion: u8(expr)/i32(expr)/i64(expr): one integer operand, preserve value, runtime trap or CT error when unrepresentable. No bool/address conversion. Typed/CT target and result must exactly agree; target types and operands are independently checked.
byte_integer.source: unsuffixed unconstrained literal remains i32. Explicit u8 context or u8 suffix permits0..255; other source suffix rejection remains. Current integer match still requires a catch-all. Conversion names are reserved only as bare value/function bindings; members are ordinary members.
byte_integer.scope: finite Copy arrays/aggregates/closures and checked CT; not UTF8 String, dynamic Vec, slices, allocation or unsafe raw-pointer casts.

implemented_partial_schema.static_foreign_constructors: c_null()/c_wstr_null()/c_wstr(literal) -> Core Literal(new Constant), c_callback(static ordinary symbol) -> ForeignFunctionRef. Callback target defined with no environment, foreign or teardown identity; exact i32/i64/handle arguments and Unit/i32/i64/handle result. No FunctionPointer conversion/CallIndirect. Foreign values closed to CT. c_wstr includes unique trailing NUL and valid UTF16, immutable program-static storage; no borrowed pointer conversion or external production.

borrowed_slice.shape: Only Address<Slice<finite Copy>> is a value. Bare Slice, nested addresses, slice-containing aggregate/error/callable/FFI/CT values are rejected. Slice is not Copy; shared Address retains existing copy behavior and mutable Address remains affine.

borrowed_slice.machine: Address<Slice<T>> is {ptr,i64}; other Address remains ptr. No heap or reference count. AddressIndex uses actual slice length and produces Address<T>. Unit/empty Copy elements use existing aggregate-field representation, never LLVM void GEP.

byte_buffer.provenance: Verify independently bridges actual resource roots, Desc aliases, ordinary call effects, dynamic-backed loans, result origins and cleanup. An address does not own storage. byte_buffer.boundary: Ordinary local/Desc/give/create/give factory and parameter-origin borrowed slice returns. byte_buffer.machine: Inline {ptr,i64,i64} managed head and pointer Desc; returned slice existing {ptr,i64}; element u8 only. Target allocator ABI and actual native execution reported separately.
byte_buffer.alias_contract: Verify infers required cross-parameter separation for windows versus writes, instantiates it at real callers and preserves dangerous prefixes. Distinct formal names never imply apart. Any conservative unsupported ordering is recorded separately; give parameters are owned local carriers and cannot source an escaping borrowed result.
byte_buffer.owning_composition: Package/capture descriptors and windows retain actual carrier roots; conservative whole-shell roots are allowed. Field take/refill/replace and whole carrier transfer/cleanup reject conflicting live windows. Intrinsic byte cleanup settles the outer responsibility flag before freeing payload; all temporary preparation and error exits settle only acquired owners. No new wire tag/opcode/layout.
